Next Action

Next action using explicit input data. Returns a deterministic result without model calls or task execution.

Signature

next_action(actions)

Example input

{
  "actions": [
    {
      "name": "Deploy",
      "blocked": true
    },
    {
      "name": "Run tests"
    }
  ]
}

Example output

{
  "name": "Run tests"
}

Run from repository root

python scripts/solve.py next_action < examples/next-action.json

Limits

Operates only on supplied data. Inspect source for validation and assumptions; this helper cannot establish real-world correctness.
